description: Invalid-input failure scenarios for DetectCross. Three sub-cases: (1) mismatched slice lengths — ErrMismatchedLengths; (2) fewer than 2 data points (empty input) — ErrInsufficientData; (3) NaN value in fastLine — ErrInvalidValue. All must return a non-nil error and nil/empty event slice.

cases.name: mismatched-lengths
cases.description: fastLine has 3 elements, slowLine has 2 — lengths do not match

cases.name: empty-input
cases.description: both slices empty — fewer than 2 data points

cases.name: nan-value-in-fast
cases.description: NaN injected at index 1 in fastLine — must be rejected

errors: ErrInsufficientData (empty slices — need at least 2 points)
expectedOutput.note: All three cases MUST return a non-nil error. Event slice MUST be nil or empty. No partial results are acceptable.
